description: This file contains utility functions for grouping and filtering Card objects based on properties, used in a board or Kanban-style interface.

methods.name: groupCardsByOptions
methods.description: Groups cards based on provided option IDs and an optional property template.

methods.name: getOptionGroups
methods.description: Separates cards into visible and hidden groups based on option IDs and property template.

methods.name: getVisibleAndHiddenGroups
methods.description: Main exported function that returns visible and hidden groups, handling special property types.

methods.name: getPersonGroups
methods.description: Groups cards by person-related properties such as createdBy or updatedBy.
